name: limit_flat_pattern_without_a_file
why: ENTRY GP18, trap 2 of the family: `ExportFlatPatternView` on a NEVER SAVED part opens «Save As» and the COM call does not return — measured with the probe, which stayed hung until the window was closed from outside. The operation must refuse BEFORE calling.

steps._the_twin_differs_by_path_and_that_is_no: The bench demands that refusal and twin differ by ONE argument (entry F5), and the first draft had none: «fake twin, identical to the refusal». Here the refusal depends on the STATE — the never saved part — and not on an argument. `path` is the only one the operation takes, and it differs to respect the rule; the difference that decides is the saving, which the twin does two steps earlier. Written so that whoever reads does not believe that it is the path that makes it refuse.
